scenarios.residual_definition: actual minus point prediction; signed blocks are not centered
scenarios.interpretation: Finite illustrative scenarios without assigned probabilities; not forecast intervals or future feasibility guarantees.
scenarios.clipping: Negative constructed demand is clipped to zero kWh.

deterministic.message: Optimal feasible schedule; independently verified constraints.

robust.message: Optimal feasible schedule; independently verified constraints.
robust.method: Exact finite-scenario LP using componentwise maximum background
robust.objective_explanation: Deterministic tariffs and fixed scenario backgrounds make flexible-cost, mean-total-cost, and worst-total-cost minimizers identical over the same robust feasible set.
robust.guarantee_scope: Constraints verified for supplied scenarios only; unseen demand may violate limits.

case_selection: First chronological pair feasible under both policies, smallest feasible configured cap; no favorable result filter.
